scope: Existing collateral, `README.md` presentation content, media, release packages and provenance-governed supporting records
Not relicensed by this software grant. Existing blocked/pending publication decisions, permissions, expiry, reviewer fields and release eligibility remain intact.

audit: The existing inventory requires all tracked paths, and the provenance register pins current README and inventory bytes. Those exact metadata references are refreshed without granting collateral publication rights.

getticketstub.com.purpose: This repository contains the TicketStub customer application and host-side integration code. Its copied runtime snapshots, customer artwork and deployment state have separate provenance and authority boundaries.
getticketstub.com.grant: the original Jevelopers source code and original technical documentation in this repository, except separately owned or excluded material identified below
scope: All pinned sibling runtime files and archives retain their separate source ownership and recorded terms. Their hashes, manifests and package metadata are not rewritten by this grant.
`public/brand/`, `public/landing/` non-code media, other existing image/illustration assets, `docs/assets/` and `src/brand/tokens.css`
Brand artwork, reference imagery, media and copied brand tokens remain outside this MIT grant. Existing delivery or distribution does not prove rights clearance.
Existing font software remains SIL OFL 1.1, with complete notices and recorded font metadata. Adding notices does not approve self-hosting or any outstanding brand/font-delivery decision.
The Cuelume credit and upstream MIT notice are preserved. A technique credit is not a transfer of upstream ownership.
Entire graph guide and generated instruction blocks
Separately owned MIT material; preserve Entire Inc. copyright and the complete notice in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
audit: The four vendored runtime directories and two runtime archives retain their manifests and exact bytes. The cost-intelligence archive already carries the TypeBox license; that embedded notice must remain with it.

Font name-table metadata was inspected for the ten existing WOFF2 files; complete family OFL texts and exact embedded copyright/version/hash records are added without adding or changing fonts. The original download chain is not proved by font metadata alone.
The existing sound-feedback source credits Cuelume; the pinned upstream MIT copyright notice agrees with that credit and is retained.

## Existing web fonts

The ten existing files in `public/landing/fonts/` identify Abril Fatface, Archivo,
Big Shoulders Display, Fraunces, IBM Plex Mono and Inter Tight. They remain under
SIL OFL 1.1 (`OFL-1.1`), not the project MIT notice. Preserve the complete family
OFL files and [font attribution record](public/landing/fonts/NOTICE.md) alongside
any distribution. The record retains font name-table copyright lines, versions,
byte hashes and pinned upstream license references. Only trailing whitespace in
new license copies is normalized; all legal wording is preserved.

Adding these notices does not approve self-hosting, production brand use or an
unverified font acquisition chain. No font file is changed or added.
## Cuelume sound-feedback attribution

`src/customer/studio/feedback.ts` credits the approach of Cuelume and distinguishes
the TicketStub sound recipes. Preserve that credit and the complete
[Cuelume MIT notice](licenses/cuelume-MIT.txt), Copyright (c) 2026 Daniel Belyi.
[Upstream LICENSE](https://github.com/danielwh2/cuelume/blob/2a1ba4fc1b67e8371c9f37e37a51e61353166335/LICENSE)
is pinned; a project credit does not transfer upstream ownership.
## Vendored sibling runtimes and embedded TypeBox

`src/server/vendor/agent-harness/`, `cost-intelligence/`, `creative-engine/` and
`fulfillment-connectors/` retain their own MANIFEST.json source records and terms.
Older snapshots without a root license are not relicensed by this repository.
Do not replace their existing files or hashes with a newer component license.

The existing `src/server/vendor/cost-intelligence/runtime.tgz` includes TypeBox,
MIT, Copyright (c) 2017-2026 Haydn Paterson, with the full notice at
`package/node_modules/@sinclair/typebox/license` inside the archive.
Preserve that actual bundled notice when unpacking or redistributing the archive;
its license is not supplied by the Jevelopers notice. [TypeBox upstream](https://github.com/sinclairzx81/typebox).

## Complete family licenses

Preserve the corresponding full SIL OFL 1.1 text with distributions:
[Abril Fatface](abrilfatface-OFL.txt), [Archivo](archivo-OFL.txt),
[Big Shoulders Display](bigshouldersdisplay-OFL.txt), [Fraunces](fraunces-OFL.txt),
[IBM Plex Mono](ibmplexmono-OFL.txt), and [Inter Tight](intertight-OFL.txt).
The license texts are from [Google Fonts at 66928797f271fed5ee428544e7229685e2d90127](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/66928797f271fed5ee428544e7229685e2d90127/ofl).
Only trailing line whitespace is normalized in the added text files; all legal
wording and Reserved Font Name provisions are retained. Font metadata and the
family license may have different copyright years; both notices are preserved.

The inspected binaries are unchanged. This record does not prove their original
download chain, approve self-hosting, or resolve any brand delivery decision.
The project software license does not supersede OFL or assert rights in the fonts.
